description: For every fixed bounded formula \(D\), PA proves that \(D(\vec x)\) implies acceptance of the specified positive builder with conclusion code \(\ulcorner D(\overline{\vec x})\urcorner\), using the internal numeral-substitution graph.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.bounded_positive_internal_full {r : ℕ}
  (D : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin r))
  (hD : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.BoundedArithmetic D) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA
    (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.close
      (D.imp
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.builderAccepted
          Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.proofFormula
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.boundedPositive D hD)
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.FixedSyntaxPrograms.substitution D))))
